notes: Husband of Roma Eloise Abernathy. Born about 1900 in Missouri to Missouri-born parents; head of the household in Central Township, St. Louis County, in 1930 with Roma, 27, and John J., 6, and in Normandy Township in 1940, widowed, with sons Pierre R. and John J. (1930 and 1940 censuses).
Born 2 Mar 1900 at Kirkwood, Missouri; registered for the draft in St. Louis in 1917–18 and again at Overland on 15 Feb 1942 (draft registration cards).
